# Marketing Leadership Model

`marketing-leadership-model` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · Growth, Retention & RevOps
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/marketing-leadership-model/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Should we hire a head of marketing, retain a fractional leader, or use an agency, on our own numbers?

**Inputs:** Your horizon, your own hourly value and monthly tools cost; for a hire, base salary, load, recruiting fee, months to find and start, ramp and your weekly management hours; for a fractional leader, retainer, execution you would still buy, ramp, management hours and notice; for an agency, retainer, setup fee, ramp, management hours and minimum term; and the hours a week of leadership and execution the work actually is

**Output:** Total cost per option over the horizon with every line, cost per productive month, your hours, the month the in-house line crosses below the retainer if it ever does, what each option has cost and still owes if you stop at month six, and an in-house, fractional, fractional-plus-execution or agency call on the shape of the work

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill marketing-leadership-model`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/marketing-leadership-model/resources/leadership-model.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/marketing-leadership-model/resources/leadership-model.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It has no benchmarks. Every salary, retainer and ramp figure is one you enter and the demo numbers are starting assumptions, so the result is only as good as your quotes.
- A ramp month counts as half productive. That is an AAJ rule, not a measurement of how fast any person or agency gets up to speed.
- The exit table prices cash only. A hire assumes no severance, and it can't price lost momentum, which the skill notes is usually the larger cost.
- The fit call uses AAJ's hour thresholds (30 hours of leadership means hire, 20 of execution needs hands). It can't judge whether a given candidate or agency is any good.

**Review before acting:** The founder checks the salary band, load and quotes are real and the execution still to buy is counted. The finance lead reruns it at 24 and 36 months before committing, and a review date is set at the crossover or the end of the minimum term.
